limitations: Structural validity is not row acceptance; every row predicate is computed independently by the verifier.
A smoke run is diagnostic only and closes no row.
One day on one host cannot prove indefinite bounded memory, every supported Kafka and Node pair, multi-host partitions or the compared consume benchmark.
The seeded control proves sensitivity to that seed only.
Performance results are report-only; no latency or throughput veto is created.

telemetryProducerRate.source: design: telemetry producer main offers per active second

transactionEveryMs.source: design: one transaction per 100 active seconds, never overlapping

visiblePerProducerKind.source: design: visible acknowledged records per producing kind

topology.routeRule: The verifier expands this table over the actual topic ids and partitions into every required (group, topic id, partition) route. A route starts at offset 0 on an empty log and seals only after producer closure, a terminal scan to the settled high watermark, handler drain and final broker commit or share acceptance; no route may start above the corpus, omit a partition, incarnation or static group, or end early.

jitterMs.source: design: periodic admission jitter around each slot target

periodicSlots.source: design: slots k = 0..2880 over the 86 400 000 ms day at the sample period

quietReadings.source: design: three matched quiet readings per idle boundary

interning-seeded.retains: Map<partition:offset, offset string> of every offset the seed's handler enters
interning-seeded.starts: immediately after the seed's first quiet triplet
interning-seeded.clears: after its last quiet triplet and before disconnect
interning-seeded.exemption: Excluded only from unseeded heap growth tests; still owes sampling, identity, resources, map clear and natural exit.

rows.obligation: Soak harness records listener, socket, queue and handle counts and retained-heap trend after warm-up and GC, with a clean exit and no forced termination; idle, regex-topic churn, member churn and outage/recovery runs; repeated producer and consumer churn gates; the final long-run evidence or an explicit reviewed replacement for the 24-hour commitment (a short churn loop cannot count as that run); evidence as JSONL.

scope.judged: all 12 unseeded subject processes; the seed only for sensitivity

rows.predicate: day PASS iff Complete && Delivery && AuthorityOK && ResourcesOK && TablesOK && HeapOK(each of the 12 unseeded subject processes) && conclusive offset-retention sensitivity. Delivery: every offered id has exactly one final ack outcome; the independent read_committed log is unique by (topic id, partition, offset) and each log id was offered with equal key, value, headers and transaction; rejected or confirmed-aborted ids are absent, acknowledged or confirmed-committed ids appear exactly once, unknown produce ids appear at most once, an unresolved transaction decision is non-green. The verifier expands the topology table over actual topic ids and partitions into every required route, independent of the driver journal; journal routes equal that expansion, start at 0 and seal at the raw terminal scan; every expected route of every group, including all static groups and the telemetry consumer, has a non-empty visible set meeting its floor, every visible record has an authorized processed handler, ordinary groups have a final broker next reaching the route end and share accepts every visible record. Committed offsets never pass the processed prefix of visible data offsets; scan-proven control and aborted gaps may be crossed. closure COMPLETE only with verified prior-checkpoint dispositions and every required companion.

scope.judged: four consuming kinds, each paired with the idempotent producer on main

rows.predicate: For each of the four consuming kinds: latency[i] = first authorized handler-enter at in its group for main id i minus the idempotent offered at; require >= 20 000 distinct ids and no negative latency. Gaps are consecutive actual handler-entry time differences on one client and run within one active phase and owner episode; cross-idle and boundary gaps are excluded and counted; require >= 20 000 actual gaps, so >= 20 001 eligible entries. Report entry counts, exclusions, histograms and p50/p90/p99 with percentile(p) = sorted[ceil(p*n)-1], never as a veto.

rows.predicate: For p in {eager-dynamic, consumer-dynamic, share, seed}: V[p] = distinct main offsets actually entered in p between its first quiet triplet completion and its last quiet triplet admission; require |V[p]| >= 1 000 000 from the same main corpus and method. The seed's HeapOK endpoint must exceed the breach bound; every unseeded process passes HeapOK. A missing, under-volume or under-bound seed is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS; a seed breach never fails an unseeded memory row. closure COMPLETE also needs the consume-retention companion with the candidate and reference retained and control report; otherwise the row stays OPEN.
